description: This is a test class for the HelpConfigService, part of the OrangeHRM Help Service module. It sets up the service, populates test data, and contains test methods for verifying the help processor class and base help URL.

classes.name: HelpConfigServiceTest
classes.description: Test case class for HelpConfigService, extending KernelTestCase to leverage testing utilities.

methods.description: Initializes the HelpConfigService and loads fixture data before each test.

methods.name: testGetBaseHelpUrl
methods.description: Verifies that getBaseHelpUrl() returns the correct base URL for help resources.
